mismatches.reason: Predicate adds an unrelated first-depositor share-control antecedent and encodes a conditional rather than the stated zero-supply-until-assets intent.

P sets constructor supply to 1,000,000 while I requires zero supply when assets are zero, so P contradicts I's condition and V's nonzero-supply conjunct is entailed by P rather than being a distinguishable violation.
Predicate encodes an implication about worthless shares rather than the intent that supply starts at zero and shares mint only when assets exist.
I is not the stated zero-supply-until-assets intent, so V's contradiction of I does not represent a direct violation of the intended invariant.
